answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial, committing to its identity while proving Semaphore-tree membership without exposing it. RLN derives a scoped nullifier from each evaluation; two messages in the same rate-limit window produce conflicting shares that reconstruct the agent’s private rate-limit key, enabling attribution and instantaneous collateral slashing. The quill records the commitment, the spiral marks successive epochs, and the river carries only proofs and nullifiers.
